Indian Bonds May Rise as Oil Falls Amid US Midterm Focus

India's benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond yield is anticipated to trade within the 7.35%-7.39% range. This potential firming of Indian bonds is linked to a slip in crude oil prices and the upcoming US midterm elections, which are also shaping bond yields. Liquidity tightness is another factor influencing yields.
